deferrals.name: uv
deferrals.reason: uv required-version bumps ride the scheduled family dependency-update fan-out (deps-update workflow), not ad-hoc PRs. Re-evaluate if the next scheduled update has not landed by the review date.

Repo targets Python 3.12/3.13 (requires-python >=3.12, CI matrix 3.12/3.13). 3.14 is pending upstream verification: openhands-sdk support for 3.14 is unconfirmed. Re-evaluate when the SDK's supported range covers 3.14.
